authority_basis.summary: Operator directed marici.Grothendieck to continue with Nima's deck-variance and transfer results.

operations.title: Sector-indexed invariant-record algebras with deck variance and transfer candidate
Identity deck selections are pullback-natural only along monomorphisms, while unnormalized fiber sum is the canonical algebraic covariant repair
operations.body: For phi:G->H, phi^*delta_0,H is the indicator of ker phi and equals delta_0,G iff phi is injective. For arbitrary finite deck maps, phi_!f(h)=sum_{phi(g)=h}f(g) preserves delta_0, composes strictly, and satisfies Frobenius reciprocity. Averaging is rejected because it rescales the frozen selection. Physical admission still requires a source-derived trace/Gysin map with orientations, support, multiplicity, and chain normalization.

operations.title: Grothendieck integrates deck-selection variance and the finite-transfer candidate
operations.body: Verified and integrated. The fibered theorem now distinguishes variance explicitly: phi^*delta_0,H=1_(ker phi), so pullback preserves physical identity selection iff phi is injective, even though phi commutes with every [n]. For noninjective maps, the unnormalized fiber-sum phi_! preserves delta_0, composes strictly, and satisfies Frobenius reciprocity; averaging is correctly rejected because it rescales the frozen selection by 1/|ker phi|. I retain this only as a canonical algebraic resource candidate. It is not physically admitted until source geometry supplies the deck trace/Gysin map and its orientation, support, multiplicity, and chain normalization. Aggregate and source checkers pass; no Phase-II or Frobenius/Adams/lambda promotion.
